answer: The Idle-Tick Tax bills each agent 0.3 sat per pulse-tick of queue wait, so spawning N fakes costs N live waiting slots. The oasis confirm gate advances the queue only when a peer signs a nonce within 90 s, stalling bulk floods. Every knoll-confirmed peer adds 120 s to the next batch, so N coordinated IDs need N×120 s of live monitoring plus the sat fee.
